deprecated-modules.rationale: The catalog defines this as a maintenance signal; review the actual deprecation status and migration context, not just the rule name.

duplicated-code.rationale: Review whether the flagged task blocks are semantically duplicated and whether reuse is appropriate; textual similarity alone is insufficient.

galaxy-meta-incomplete.rationale: This is an optional publication-metadata policy; judge whether Galaxy publication is in scope before judging actionability.

insufficient-modularization.rationale: The decision concerns play/task decomposition and reuse, even though the catalog currently labels it a maintainability signal.

loop-legacy-syntax.rationale: This is a compatibility/deprecation predicate; determine whether the syntax is actually legacy for the supported Ansible context.

missing-abstraction.rationale: The question is whether task organization should be factored into reusable roles/includes, not whether a numeric size cutoff is exceeded.

missing-bool-filters.rationale: The predicate is a variable/value-type interpretation in a when condition; judge expression semantics and available type context.

molecule-test-absent.rationale: This is an optional testing-practice predicate; role testability and repository policy value must be judged separately from file absence.

non-idempotent-command.rationale: Judge whether the mutating command can repeat harmful changes without a valid idempotency guard; command presence alone is insufficient.

overriding-facts.rationale: Requires comparing set_fact assignments and whether the later value changes the effective variable; context can make apparent overrides intentional.

read-only-command-change.rationale: Judge whether the command is read-only and whether Ansible would falsely report a change in this actual task context.

redirected-module.rationale: This is a module-identity/compatibility condition; verify the redirect and target FQCN in the frozen source context.

redundant-default-value.rationale: Requires comparing an assignment to the role default and the effective variable contract; equality alone may be intentional documentation.

role-readme-absent.rationale: The supplied plan explicitly places absent role documentation in the structure/reuse review family; absence alone is not a correctness defect.

role-variable-precedence-collision.rationale: Requires Ansible precedence and effective-value reasoning across role defaults and vars.

shell-environment-export.rationale: The issue is whether a shell export is being used where Ansible's task environment mapping controls variable propagation.

unguarded-variable.rationale: The finding is about whether a variable is defined, guarded, or supplied by a runtime input contract; uncertainty is central to this family.

unnecessary-abstraction.rationale: A one-task block is a structure/reuse judgment; its presence does not by itself establish a harmful abstraction.

unnecessary-set-fact.rationale: Judge whether the set_fact value is genuinely unused across visible references; do not treat the optional rule taxonomy as proof of a defect.

unpinned-ansible-dependency.rationale: Judge whether the dependency is genuinely unconstrained in the declared installation source; reproducibility impact and actionability are separate labels.

unsafe-file-write.rationale: The supplied plan explicitly lists unsafe file writes as a security review case; judge actual write risk and relevant safeguards.

unscoped-shell-variable.rationale: Requires checking shell-variable expansion against Ansible environment mapping and execution scope.

unused-registered-variable.rationale: The semantic decision is whether a registered result is referenced in the available scope; dynamic/runtime references may require uncertainty.

variable-use-before-definition.rationale: Requires ordering and scope reasoning about the registered result/fact; external or dynamic definitions must be considered.

vault-inline-overload.rationale: The detector concerns inline encrypted-secret handling; assess exposure/operational risk while keeping the organization-specific threshold distinct.

scope_note: Rule-definition mapping only; no finding occurrence rows, reviewer samples, human labels, or heldout contexts are read or written.
